title: ci(test-core): three different cases hit the vitest 5 s default timeout under load in 24 h; measure the shards and fix the timeout class, not one case at a time
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ① a repeatedly red platform test class, measured from the Actions job logs. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: p1, under the standing order that a repeatedly red platform test gets fixed.

## 维护者速读

24 小时内，`Test Core` 分片里**三个不同的用例**都卡在 vitest 默认的 5 秒超时上：cli 的 `validate-build-gate-parity`（#30785）、rest 的币种回填用例（#30873）、今天 09:05Z 让 main 推送红的 formula `expression-refusal-codes`。三次都是负载下才超时，下一次推送又绿。一个个修用例只治标；需要量一下分片负载并处理这一类。

## Measured

| When | Where | Case |
|---|---|---|
| 11-05 18:18Z, 11-06 02:17Z | `main` push / merge group `pr-30753`, `Test Core (4/8)` | `packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts` → #30785 |
| 11-06 ~08:00Z | `Test Core (6/8)` | rest record-currency backfill capability control case → #30873 |
| 11-06 09:05Z | `main` push `CI` on `d55acb78`, `Test Core (4/8)`, job 127808107135 (green again on `98f640d5`) | `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal-codes.test.ts` › "every refusal validateExpression reports on the sweep carries a code from the closed set" |

## Wanted

- Measure per-shard wall time and the slowest cases on loaded runners (`scripts/test-shard-timings.json` and the shard plan). The cases that sit near 5 s on an idle runner are the population.
- Fix the class: rebalance the shards, cut the heavy work out of these cases (#30785's own finding: a per-character masker run over every file), and/or set explicit per-case timeouts sized from the measurement, each with its reason. ⛔ No global timeout raise without measurement, no skip, no retry.
- #30785 and #30873 stay their own fixes. This card owns the measurement and the formula case.
- Related: #25870 (Test Core's slowest shards, `pm:on-hold`).

Reader: `domain:devx` (CI health, the shard plan). The formula case is `packages/formula`.
